text:
Elaine Walker: Quick idea  a tiny dev series: 3 snackable tutorials (~7min each) + sample app + blog. Goal: prototype Redwood in a day, CTA = $100 credits + gated webinar.

Marco Chen: Nice. Pair each tutorial with a micro-benchmark: latency, cost/batching, private deploy checklist. One chart + 1 takeaway each.

Priya Nair: Distribution: carousel posts, long-form blog, gated workshop/webinar -> SDR funnel.

Samir Patel: Routing: add utm_campaign=snackloop, source=snackable-tutorials, and a field for expected_tokens_per_call to route high-usage leads.

Dana Ortiz: Copy angle: "Ship an LLM feature in a day  predictable latency, lower cost." Include short code snippet in blog.

Marco Chen: Im adding a bench script to repo: `python tools/bench_latency.py --model redwood-3b --seq 128 --n 50`. Will push chart png + csv.

Priya Nair: Im on blog + webinar outline. Samir take form/HubSpot, Marco sample app, Dana socials & vids. Elaine to coordinate cadence.

Samir Patel: Form fields: utm_campaign, source_tier, expected_tokens_per_call. Add optional "Request Dedicated demo" checkbox to flag enterprise intent.

Dana Ortiz: Visuals: 3x15s clips + 60s overview. Need latency chart png + csv to animate. Storyboards by Fri EOD.

Marco Chen: Repo structure: `/tutorials/snackloop/01-latency`, `/02-cost`, `/03-private`. Default seq=128 in examples.

Elaine Walker: KPIs: blog views, 50% video completion, webinar signups, 30d conversion, lead score spread.

Priya Nair: Webinar: 35m demo + 15m QA. Follow-up email with ops deep-dives.

PublishingBot: Event created: "Snackloop tutorial launch" on 2026-05-14 10:00 PDT  landing: https://redwood.example/landing/snackloop (draft).

Elaine Walker: Action items: Priya (Tue), Marco (Wed AM), Samir (Wed EOD), Dana (Fri EOD). I'll assign in Asana and announce on launch day.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
